Interface WayangOrchestratorSpi

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractGamelanWorkflowEngine, GamelanWorkflowEngine
public interface WayangOrchestratorSpi
Service Provider Interface for Wayang Orchestration. Defines the contract that must be implemented to execute a Wayang definition (e.g. via Gamelan Local or Remote).
